translations.web: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.
translations.bsb: Moreover, all his days he eats in darkness, with much sorrow, sickness, and anger.
translations.kjv: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.
translations.asv: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he is sore vexed, and hath sickness and wrath.
